resources.string: Enable the Quick Tiles accessibility service first
Grant Do Not Disturb access in the Quick Tiles app to change this volume
Lets the Power tile open the system power menu. It does not read your screen or collect any data.
Adds 11 Quick Settings tiles: Power, plus volume up and volume down for Media, Ringtone, Notification, Alarm and Call.
1. Swipe down twice to open Quick Settings, tap the edit (pencil) button and drag the Quick Tiles tiles into your panel.
2. The Power tile needs the accessibility service. It only opens the system power menu.
3. Ringtone and Notification tiles need Do Not Disturb access to lower the volume to vibrate or silent.
Do Not Disturb access: not granted
If the accessibility switch is greyed out (Android 13 and newer, sideloaded APK), open App info, tap the three-dot menu, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
